title: Add character creation draft state and dependency-aware validation engine
description:
Replace brittle whole-prompt character creation validation with a stateful draft and pure creation engine. This covers the core failure modes from eshyra-4jiu.

Required behavior
- Preserve prior answers across revisions.
- Validate fields incrementally.
- Avoid validation cascades when prerequisites are missing or invalid.
- Track stale/invalidated dependent choices when class, ancestry, scores, or spellcasting context changes.
- Allow ability scores to exist before class and class to exist before ability scores.
- HP validation waits for both class hit die and Constitution modifier.

Acceptance criteria
- CharacterCreationDraft or equivalent serializable state exists.
- CharacterCreationEngine or equivalent pure domain layer can apply changes, validate, compute derived values, and report missing required choices without terminal I/O.
- Changing name does not reset mechanical choices.
- Changing class preserves identity and scores but invalidates/revalidates class-specific choices.
- Changing ancestry preserves base scores and recomputes final scores/derived values.
- Tests cover invalid class, invalid ancestry, non-integer scores, point-buy out-of-range scores, missing name after revision, and HP validation only when prerequisites are valid.
notes: PR #287 (open for review): https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/287 — CharacterDraft + pure CharacterCreationEngine; abilities.ts shared math. Internal-only; consumed by b69j.6/.8/.9/.12/.13.
